# Covered California

> > California's official health insurance marketplace providing affordable coverage options, financial assistance, and access to Medi-Cal for eligible residents.

Covered California connects California residents with health insurance plans across multiple coverage levels (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum) and public programs like Medi-Cal. The platform offers comprehensive enrollment support, plan comparison tools, and supplemental coverage options including dental and vision insurance.

## Key Topics

- Covered California
- Medi-Cal
- Coverage Levels (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum)

## Getting Started

- [Covered California | The Official Site of California's Health Insurance Marketplace](https://www.coveredca.com): Official California health insurance marketplace connecting residents with financial assistance
- [Get Started](https://www.coveredca.com/get-started): Enrollment guide and application process for Covered California health insurance
- [Support](https://www.coveredca.com/support): Support hub for plan comparison, financial assistance, and account management
- [Contact Us](https://www.coveredca.com/support/contact-us): Customer service contact information and local enrollment assistance

## Health Insurance Coverage Plans

- [Bronze Coverage](https://www.coveredca.com/health/coverage-levels/bronze): Bronze plan details with HSA eligibility and high deductible options
- [Silver Coverage](https://www.coveredca.com/health/coverage-levels/silver): Silver coverage levels (70, 73, 87, 94) with HMO and PPO options
- [Gold Coverage](https://www.coveredca.com/health/coverage-levels/gold): Gold level coverage with HMO, PPO, and EPO plan options
- [Platinum Coverage](https://www.coveredca.com/health/coverage-levels/platinum): Platinum coverage with no deductibles and lowest service prices

## Medi-Cal Program

- [Medi-Cal](https://www.coveredca.com/health/medi-cal): Medi-Cal free or low-cost health services for qualifying Californians
- [Medi-Cal for Individuals and Families](https://www.coveredca.com/health/medi-cal/individuals-and-families): Medi-Cal eligibility and enrollment for individuals and families
- [Medi-Cal for Children](https://www.coveredca.com/health/medi-cal/children): Free or low-cost Medi-Cal coverage for children under age 19
- [Medi-Cal for Pregnancy](https://www.coveredca.com/health/medi-cal/pregnant-women): Medi-Cal pregnancy coverage with prenatal and postpartum care

## Dental Coverage

- [Dental](https://www.coveredca.com/dental/family): Dental coverage for families with included children's dental care
- [Children's Dental](https://www.coveredca.com/dental/childrens-dental): Children's dental insurance included with health plans via multiple carriers
- [Add-On Family Dental: What You'll Pay for Your Dental Care](https://www.coveredca.com/dental/adult-add-on/hmo): Adult dental add-on plan costs and copay schedules for HMO plans

## Vision Coverage

- [Adult Vision](https://www.coveredca.com/vision/adult): Adult vision insurance through EyeMed and VSP with enrollment options
- [Children's Vision](https://www.coveredca.com/vision/childrens-vision): Free vision care for children under 19 included with health plans

## Resources & Education

- [Covered California Blog](https://www.coveredca.com/marketing-blog): Health insurance news, enrollment guides, and wellness education content
